project_summary: Replatforming of a home decoration store from Magento to Laravel

components.name: Data migration from MySQL to PostgreSQL
components.description: Migration of products, customers and order history from the Magento MySQL database to PostgreSQL, with incremental sync and a cut-over plan for zero downtime.

components.name: SEO URL redirects
components.description: Mapping of legacy Magento URLs to the new routes with permanent redirects, sitemap regeneration and broken link monitoring.

components.name: Promotions engine
components.description: Coupon codes, percentage and fixed discounts, buy-x-get-y rules and free shipping thresholds applied at cart level.

components.name: Content CMS
components.description: Editable landing pages, banners and inspiration articles for the marketing team using a block-based editor.
